1.text: Umuseke utambitse, uwo mwanya abatambyi bakuru n'abakuru n'abanditsi, n'abanyarukiko bose bajya inama baboha Yesu, baramujyana bamushyira Pilato.

2.text: Pilato aramubaza ati “Ni wowe mwami w'Abayuda?”Na we aramusubiza ati “Wakabimenye.”

4.text: Pilato yongera kumubaza ati “Mbese nta cyo wireguza ko bakureze byinshi?”

5.text: Ariko Yesu ntiyagira ikindi amusubiza, bituma Pilato atangara.

6.text: Nuko muri iyo minsi mikuru, uko umwaka utashye yari yaramenyereye kubohorera abantu imbohe imwe, iyo babaga bamusabye.

7.text: Nuko muri icyo gihe hariho uwitwaga Baraba wabohanywe n'abari bagomye, bishe abantu muri ubwo bugome.

8.text: Abantu barazamuka, batangira gusaba ko abagirira nk'uko yamenyereye.

9.text: Pilato arababaza ati “Murashaka ko mbabohorera umwami w'Abayuda?”

10.text: Kuko yamenye yuko ishyari ari ryo ryatumye abatambyi bakuru bamutanga.

11.text: Maze abatambyi bakuru boshya rubanda bati “Ahubwo Baraba abe ari we ababohorera.”

12.text: Pilato yongera kubabaza ati “Ndamugira nte uwo mwita umwami w'Abayuda?”

14.text: Pilato arababaza ati “Kuki? Yakoze cyaha ki?”Maze barushaho gusakuza cyane bati “Mubambe.”

15.text: Nuko Pilato ashatse gushimisha abantu ababohorera Baraba, amaze gukubita Yesu imikoba aramutanga ngo abambwe.

16.text: Maze abasirikare bamujyana imbere mu rugo rw'urukiko, bahamagara ingabo zose ziraterana.

17.text: Bamwambika umwenda w'umuhengeri, baboha ikamba ry'amahwa bararimwambika,

18.text: baherako batangira kumuramutsa bati “Ni amahoro, mwami w'Abayuda!”

19.text: Bamukubita urubingo mu mutwe, bamucira amacandwe, barapfukama baramuramya.

20.text: Bamaze kumushinyagurira bamwambura wa mwenda w'umuhengeri, bamwambika imyenda ye baramusohokana, bamujyana kumubamba.

21.text: Batangīra umugenzi waturukaga imusozi witwaga Simoni w'Umunyakurene, ari we se wa Alekizanderi na Rufo, baramuhata ngo yikorere umusaraba wa Yesu.

22.text: Bamujyana ahitwa i Gologota, hasobanurwa ngo “I Nyabihanga.”

23.text: Baha Yesu vino ivanze na sumuruna, ariko ntiyayinywa.

24.text: Baramubamba, bagabana imyenda ye bayifindiye ngo umuntu amenye uwo ari butware.

26.text: Urwandiko rw'ikirego rwandikwa hejuru ye, ngo “UMWAMI W'ABAYUDA.”

27.text: Bamubambana n'abambuzi babiri, umwe iburyo bwe, n'undi ibumoso. [

28.text: Ni bwo ibyanditswe byasohoye ngo “Yabaranywe n'abanyabyaha.”]

29.text: Abahisi baramutuka, bamuzunguriza imitwe bavuga bati “Ngaho wowe usenya urusengero ukarwubaka mu minsi itatu,

31.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi na bo baramucyurira, bamushinyagurira batyo barengurana bati “Yakijije abandi, ntabasha kwikiza.

32.text: Kristo, Umwami w'Abisirayeli! Namanuke ave ku musaraba nonaha, tubirebe twemere.”Ndetse n'abari babambanywe na we baramutuka.

33.text: Maze isaha zibaye esheshatu, haba ubwirakabiri mu gihugu cyose bugeza ku isaha ya cyenda.

34.text: Ku isaha ya cyenda Yesu avuga ijwi rirenga ati “Eloyi, Eloyi, lama sabakitani?” Risobanurwa ngo “Mana yanjye, Mana yanjye, ni iki kikundekesheje?”

35.text: Maze bamwe mu bahagaze aho babyumvise baravuga ngo “Dorere, arahamagara Eliya.”

36.text: Nuko umwe arirukanka yenda sipongo ayuzuza inzoga ikerēta, ayishyira ku rubingo arayimusomesha ati “Reka turebe ko Eliya aza kumubambūra.”

37.text: Maze Yesu avuga ijwi rirenga, umwuka urahera.

38.text: Umwenda ukingiriza Ahera cyane h'urusengero utabukamo kabiri, uhereye hejuru ukageza hasi.

39.text: Umutware utwara umutwe w'abasirikare wari uhagaze yerekeye Yesu, abonye apfuye atyo aravuga ati “Ni ukuri uyu muntu yari Umwana w'Imana.”

40.text: Hari n'abagore bari bahagaze kure bareba, muri bo harimo Mariya Magadalena, na Mariya nyina wa Yakobo muto na Yosefu, na Salome.

41.text: Abo ubwo yabaga i Galilaya ni bo bamukurikiraga bamukorera, n'abandi bagore benshi bazamukanye i Yerusalemu.

42.text: Bugorobye kuko wari umunsi wo Kwitegura, ari wo munsi ubanziriza isabato,

43.text: Yosefu Umunyarimataya, umujyanama w'icyubahiro kandi na we yategerezaga ubwami bw'Imana, aratinyuka ajya kwa Pilato asaba intumbi ya Yesu.

44.text: Ariko Pilato yari agitangara yuko yaba amaze gupfa, ni ko guhamagaza umutware w'abasirikare, amubaza yuko amaze gupfa koko.

45.text: Amaze kubyemezwa n'umutware w'abasirikare aha Yosefu intumbi.

46.text: Na we agura umwenda w'igitare, arayibambūra ayizingira muri uwo mwenda w'igitare, amushyira mu mva ye yakorogoshowe mu rutare, abirindurira igitare ku munwa w'imva.

47.text: Mariya Magadalena na Mariya nyina wa Yosefu babona aho ahambwe.
